notes.title: Octahedron is now self published (+ a small update)!
notes.notes:
Just a quick announcement to say that the publishing rights for Octahedron have now returned to Demimonde (the game's developer... that's me 👋)!

To celelebrate, the game is now 90% off for the Steam Winter Sale. The game also received a small update, and the following have been added:

[list]
[*]A brand new Japanese localization.
[*]An updated, much nicer looking Cyrillic font, based on the the game's main pixel font. Many thanks to Discord community member Fox Nóvak, who created the new font!
[/list]

[b]If you've played the game, and haven't yet left a review, it would help out tremendously if you could leave one![/b]

Happy holidays, everyone! 🎄🎁🎮

notes.title: Octahedron s free Transfixed Edition upgrade now pumping
notes.notes:
Bouncy beat-booming platformer Octahedron has pump-pump-pump-pumped it up with the launch of its Transfixed Edition, a free update bringing to PC the features added in its Nintendo Switch release. These include an easy difficulty setting, medals for time trials as incentive to do jumping better, and more cheevos too. I’ve not played Octahedron but I know our Dave was a fan of bouncing around as a digifella who can create his own platforms while bopping to beats made on computers.

notes.title: Transfixed, Free, Forever
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32192578/ecb17efd934009add63f95d34056e27b7752c910.png[/img]

Hot on the heels of Octahedron: Transfixed Edition’s Switch release, I’m delighted to announce that all Steam copies of Octahedron have been upgraded to the Transfixed Edition for free! Download the game now to try it out!

I spend quite a bit of time chatting with players on Twitch, Twitter, Discord and the Steam forums, and I really wanted the Transfixed Edition to be the definitive version of Octahedron. So incorporating feedback and requests from the community was very important. And I’m happy to finally have all the new content available on PC as well!

Here are some of the major things that have been added to the Transfixed Edition:

[h1][b]Time Trial Medals [/b][/h1]

Right from the start, a core focus in Octahedron has been encouraging and rewarding elegant and precise movement. The ability to pull platforms from thin air is the central pillar around which the game is designed after all. 

The desire to reward an economy of movement is what led to the end of level platform count and the Platform Par Medals. You are rewarded for a mindful & minimalist approach to platforming. But shortly after release it became apparent that gamers wanted more... The outcry for level timers from the community was immense, with speedrunners in particular taking a shine to the game.

At first I had simply introduced level completion timers and best level time displays. But with this update I’m bringing brand new Time Trial Medals to the game. Each level now comes with two finely tuned time trial tiers. Getting the PLUS version of these medals in particular is no easy task and will put even the best players through their paces!

[h1][b]Additional Achievements[/b][/h1]

Because apparently there weren’t already enough challenging feats for even the most hardcore of players to achieve I’ve thrown in even more Steam Achievements! Most of these new achievements are for unique level challenges, there’s even two stealth challenges in there. You can check out the new achievements and compare your progress toward becoming the very best, with the rest of the world, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/434660/achievements/]here[/url]. 

[h1][b]Easy Difficulty Setting[/b][/h1]

Octahedron is a challenging game, no doubt. And while it’s supposed to be, there are also those players who got stuck somewhere along the way but would have loved to keep playing—things just got a bit too difficult. For those there’s now a brand new option to switch a Normal save file to Easy!

You can start any new save file on Easy or switch an existing Normal file to Easy at any time (from the pause menu on the world map). You will only take half damage from that point forward. Please bear in mind that moving to Easy cannot be undone (on the save file in question). So think carefully before flipping that switch. 


Some smaller elements of the Transfixed Edition have been rolled out slowly since the beginning of the year. Here’s a quick summary of the changes:

[list]
[*] Engine upgrade from Game Maker Studio 1.4 to 2.2, along with many code optimizations
[*] A "HELP" option on the level end stat screen that helps explain medals, collectables, etc.
[*] A new "COPY FILE" menu on the title screen
[*] A new "PERFORMANCE MODE" option with two settings (Medium and High): This gives a further performance boost at a minimal visual cost, useful when playing on very weak CPU/GPU systems or when streaming the game.
[*] New options on completed save files:
[*] turn off optional upgrades
[*] only play levels with the minimum required platform upgrade
[*] Level design improvements
[*] Many small bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Octahedron update news
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32192578/f2497470dceb647a2179c84ef4e732826b701bbb.png[/img]

While porting the game to the Switch (out on January 17!) Octahedron was moved to a new engine and has seen many code optimizations along the way. The Steam version has just been updated to version 1.2.4.4! Since the game's release in March 2018 there have been several updates, adding new features and improvements, as well as fixing bugs. The following is a summary of all the major things that have been added since launch (including the newest update):

(1.2.4.4)
[list]
[*] upgraded engine from Game Maker Studio 1.4 to 2.0
[*] new "HELP" option on level stat screen to explain medals, diamonds etc.
[*] new "COPY FILE" menu
[*] new "PERFORMANCE MODE" option: gives a further performance boost at a minimal visual cost, useful when playing on very weak CPU/GPU systems or when streaming the game
[*] new options on completed save files: turn off optional upgrades and only play levels with the minimum required platform upgrade
[/list]

(1.0.7.4)
[list]
[*] option to display speedrunning timers added (global and per level)
[*] added tracking and saving of best level times (visible on pause stat screen)
[/list]

(1.0.6.1)
[list]
[*] for higher difficulty levels there is now a "SKIP TUTORIAL LEVEL" option in the pause menu during the tutorial level
[*] after a "Game Over" in Rogue or Rogue Extra mode there is now an option to "QUICK RESTART FROM LEVEL 1-1", so restarting the game with the intro and the tutorial level is no longer necessary
[/list]

For more details and specific bug fixes, please refer to the pinned release notes in the Steam community discussions.

notes.title: The bestest and most top PC games of 2018 so far
notes.notes:
We’re just about halfway through 2018 (which has somehow taken both too long and no time at all). As is tradition, we’ve shaken our our brains around to see which games from the last six months still make our neurons fizzle with delight. Then we wrote about them here, in this big list feature that you’re reading right now this second.

And what games they are! 2018 has been a great year so far, and our top picks run the whole range, from hand drawn oddities made by one person, to big mega-studio blockbusters that took the work of hundreds. And each of them is special to us in some way. Just like you are too. Click through the arrows to see the full spread of our faves so far. Better luck next year to the games that didn’t make the cut this time.

notes.title: Octahedron wants you to climb-dance your way to Heaven
notes.notes:
There’s a new psychedelic rhythm-synced action platformer on the market today. Octahedron let’s you surf through a pulsating, underground world on platforms pulled from thin air in this challenging psychedelic action game that has you defying gravity to a pumping beat. I always love to platform upwards, and there simply aren’t enough dance platformers in the world today.
